name: column-children
description: Column with three static Text children. Checks child ordering (children[] must be in author order) and monotonic id assignment for the un-keyed inner nodes. Root has a stable key; children rely on encoder-assigned ids.
note: Encoder output is [root, lastChild, ..., firstChild] because children[] is appended to nodes[] before the parent and the whole array is then reversed so root is first. The `children` field INSIDE each node preserves author order — only the flat array is reverse-traversal order. This mirrors the TS Encoder + flatten() in engine/src/types/widget.ts.
